title: Thai-Style Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful dish made with leftover rice, vegetables, and spices. Serve with your favorite chili sauce or fresh herbs.
instructions: Heat the lard or oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the browned onions and cook until fragrant.
Push the onions to one side of the pan.
Add a little more oil if needed, then crack in 2 eggs.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then mix with the onions.
Add the cooked rice to the pan, breaking up any clumps.
Stir-fry the rice with the egg and onion mixture for about 5 minutes.
Add the sweet chili sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
